notes.title: We added coupons !
notes.content:
Today we published little update which adds Steam coupons. Now you can get discount coupon from crafting badges up to 90% off the game !

Thanks for support and playing our game ! ːSpiritWhiteː

notes.title: Total update V.1.3
notes.content:
ːSpiritWhiteː Good evening to everyone ! Today we released new update, which is our biggest update and probably the last update which adding new things. Next ones will be only patches of bugs reported by you. Thank you for support and please give us the most important thing, feedback. Good night and have a nice day ! ːSpiritWhiteː



 Launch game option is in settings menu now, where you can choose if you want to run game in fullscreen or window
 A new design of menu and settings
 Added new menu "Level selection"
 Added 3 location and another boss (total: 30 levels + 3
boss)
 Added new traps for 3 locations
 Added a new soundtrack for the 3 location, as well as for the 
boss
 Added 2 video story-telling slideshows
 Converted music files to to reduce game size on disk
 Removed the green bar at loading

notes.title: New language + bug fixes update v.1.2
notes.content:
Today we released another update. Main things included are:


  czech language added
  fixed FPS drop at respawn
  improved performance

 Thank you for playing our game !

notes.title: Day one patch is LIVE ! v.1.1
notes.content:
Today we released new hot-fix patch, which includes those improvements:

 bursting sound when collecting items

sound setting has been reworked

fixed bug, when you can pass around saw without dying in level 5

fixed soundless saw in level 10

made settings menu faster

fixed rare bug, when you die at the begin of level and game over is shown

fixed playing music when spirit is dead in first boss level 


Thank you for all that feedback you gave to us ! Keep going and help us make game even better ! ːSpiritWhiteː
________________________________________________________

notes.title: Spirit of Maya is live now !
notes.content:
YES, we did it ! Our game is live now with start up discount. We would like to say  "Thank you" to every Steam member and especially our Greenlight voters !


So go try out our game and don't forget to leave review or report possible bug in discussions.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27365434/cceda89b5829fcaec5374759e079576506eab593.jpg

 Thank you again !
